environment.description: Same Spring Boot application on EKS. ALB ingress annotation `alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-type` is not used for this path. Instead, the cluster runs an Istio service mesh (v1.19) with a PeerAuthentication resource in STRICT mode on the namespace, requiring mTLS between the ingress gateway and the workload. The Istio ingress gateway has a Gateway resource with a `credentialName` referencing a Kubernetes secret containing a CA bundle (`inventory-client-ca`) and `tls.mode: MUTUAL`. The VirtualService routes `/api/v2/inventory/*` only through this gateway. The CA bundle is an internal PKI root that issues certificates exclusively to registered service accounts via cert-manager with a ClusterIssuer bound to the `inventory-clients` RBAC group. External traffic hitting the AWS NLB (L4, passthrough mode) is forwarded raw to the Istio ingress gateway on port 8443, which terminates mTLS and rejects connections without a valid client certificate signed by the internal CA. There is no ALB in this path — the NLB operates at TCP layer only.
